<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Pardon me, <$cdef(27)><$cname;0(272)></color>...

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>It just moved again! It really does seem to mirror your

<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,2)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Y’know what? I’m just gonna stop thinkin’ about it!

is

<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Oh, what a wonderful thought! <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>I’m sure they’ll come up

<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Yooo! That’d be PERFECT! It’d make our parties SO much
